q1.explanationZh: 爸爸问 Daisy 是不是又丢了钥匙，她说钥匙在口袋里；她找不到的是围巾（It’s my scarf, I can’t find it）。A 错：钥匙在她口袋里；C 错：钱包是妈妈的，只是她放围巾的位置。

q2.explanationZh: 男孩家住顶楼，能看到整座城市，但他说卧室窗外只能看到一个大停车场（a big car park）。A 错：城市风景是从家里其他地方看到的，不是从卧室；C 错：对话里没提公园。

q3.explanationZh: 男孩说那家咖啡馆的奶酪三明治很好吃，女孩提议今天一起吃披萨，男孩说“好主意”。B 错：三明治只是男孩提到的；C 错：女孩喜欢沙拉，但男孩说他今晚可能会吃沙拉。

q4.explanationZh: 男孩以为 Calum 要在体育中心办泳池派对，女孩说他想在自家花园里办烧烤（a barbecue in his garden），男孩也同意。C 错：泳池派对是以前的想法；B 错：咖啡馆只是他们平时吃汉堡的地方。

q5.explanationZh: 男孩提议在电影院外面见，女孩说电影院总是很挤，不如在他下电车的电车站见面，男孩同意了。B 错：电影院外面人太多；A 错：图书馆只是说明车站就在附近的拐角处。

q6.explanationZh: 老师说每个人的画的题目必须是“Buildings（建筑）”，可以画镇上的房子，也可以画城堡、宫殿。houses、castles、palaces 都只是例子。

q7.explanationZh: 5 月 9 日起可以交画，但最晚要在 18 号（by the eighteenth）之前交，所以截止日期是 5 月 18 日。9 日是开始交画的日子，20 日是公布获奖者的日子。

q8.explanationZh: 评委叫 Jacob Fossley，老师把姓拼了出来：F-O-double S-L-E-Y，double S 表示两个 s。

q9.explanationZh: 老师说 Jacob 住在本镇，是一位有名的摄影师（a famous photographer）。

q10.explanationZh: 奖品不是上次比赛的笔记本电脑，而是一块滑板（a skateboard），因为滑板是学校里最受欢迎的爱好。laptop 是干扰项。

q11.explanationZh: Dan 说今年去湖边（the lake）的学校旅行比去年去海边好多了。B 错：海边是去年去的；A 错：去河边的是另一个班。

q12.explanationZh: Dan 最爱骑马，而 Martha 说她特别喜欢在小路上骑自行车（riding our bikes），所以她最喜欢的是骑车。B 错：喜欢骑马的是 Dan；C 错：帆板是她以后想学的。

q13.explanationZh: Dan 说要学的东西很多，他总是忘记下一步该做什么，所以难的是记住指令。C 错：老师讲得很清楚；B 错：大家互相帮助。

q14.explanationZh: Martha 说她带了游泳用品，但那天太冷了（such a cold day），所以没去游泳。C 错：她带了泳衣；A 错：她说水深对她从来不是问题。

q15.explanationZh: Dan 觉得烧烤的地方有点脏，Martha 不同意；但两人都觉得离开得太早了——Martha 说“我们不得不那么早离开”，Dan 回答“I know”。A 错：两人对地点看法不同；C 错：Dan 说大家玩得很开心，一点也不无聊。

q16.explanationZh: 女孩本来也想买巧克力，但她的兄弟已经买了；她在新市场看到一副耳环，打算明天去买，耳环属于首饰（jewellery）。B 错：巧克力是兄弟买的；A 错：T 恤是她同学 Ben 买的。

q17.explanationZh: 男孩要在 5:30 前把书还回市图书馆，但训练结束太晚，请妈妈帮他去还书。A 错：杂志是他要买给妈妈的；B 错：自行车爆胎了，但他没让妈妈去修。

q18.explanationZh: 男孩说午饭时的乒乓球比赛是一天中最棒的部分（the best bit of the day）。B 错：历史课上的纪录片有点无聊；C 错：他忘带吉他，没法排练音乐会。

q19.explanationZh: 男孩周四去画画，女孩那天去打篮球；男孩说他周三也打篮球（I do that on Wednesdays），所以两人都喜欢去的是运动俱乐部。B 错：只有男孩去美术；C 错：唱诗班只有男孩去，女孩已经不去爵士乐队了。

q20.explanationZh: 男孩说主演演得不好（The main actor was no good），女孩也同意，所以他们不喜欢的是其中一位明星。A 错：他们说电影不算太长；C 错：女孩觉得结局挺有意思。

q21.explanationZh: Jake 本想帮忙卖票，但卖票的人已经很多了，所以他会在大家结束后打扫房间，也就是演出后收拾整理（tidy up afterwards）。F 错：卖票是他原本想做的。

q22.explanationZh: Alice 问 Suzy 是不是负责拍照，Jake 说她决定改为帮忙化妆（help with the make-up）。A 错：拍照的是 Dan。

q23.explanationZh: Alice 问“那 Dan 来拍照吗？”，Jake 说是的，他很喜欢拍照，所以 Dan 当摄影师。H 错：他说拍照比收拾整理容易。

q24.explanationZh: Lauren 平时负责做服装，但这次她负责做海报，贴在学校各处。C 错：做衣服是她平时做的事。

q25.explanationZh: George 会把房间布置好，为演出做准备（getting the room ready），也就是 prepare the room。F 错：他不喜欢卖票之类的事。

content.v: Test Three. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. What has the girl lost?
What are you looking for, Daisy? Have you lost your key again?
I’ve got that, Dad. It’s in my pocket.
OK.
It’s my scarf, I can’t find it and I’ll need it today. I left it in the kitchen yesterday, next to Mum’s purse and it’s not there now.
Two. What can the boy see from his bedroom window?
Don’t you live in those flats near the river?
Yeah – we’re on the top floor. We can see out over the whole city.
Lucky you! The view from my window’s really boring.
Oh, well, I can’t see it from my bedroom – that just has a view of a big car park. Why don’t you come and visit one day?
Sure.
Three. What do they decide to eat?
Mum gave me some money so we can have lunch at the café in the shopping centre.
Oh, brilliant! They make delicious cheese sandwiches there.
Well, I really like the salads, but why don’t we share a pizza today? I’m so hungry.
OK, great idea! I’ve never had one there. And I will probably have a salad tonight anyway.
Four. Where will Calum’s birthday party be?
Where’s Calum having his birthday party? He was talking about having a pool party at the sports centre.
Oh? Last time I spoke to him, he wanted to have a barbecue in his garden.
Oh, yes, you’re right! He asked us to bring something to eat.
Yeah. I’m taking some burgers. He always has those when we go to the café.
Five. Where will the friends meet tomorrow?
Do you still want to go and see a film tomorrow?
Yeah! Shall I meet you outside the cinema? I’ll get the tram.
Why don’t I meet you at your tram stop when you get off, instead? It’s always busy at the cinema.
Good idea. The stop’s just round the corner from the library.
Great! See you there at three thirty.
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher telling his class about an art competition.

Hello everyone. I want to tell you about our next school art competition. All students who are aged between eleven and sixteen can enter the competition. Not just students in our year who are nearly all thirteen.
Now, the title for everyone’s painting must be Buildings. These can be ones you know, like houses in our town. Or perhaps ones you’ve never visited like castles or palaces.
You can give your painting to the art teacher from the ninth of May, but you must give it to her by the eighteenth. And you’ll learn who has won the competition on the twentieth of May.

We’re lucky that a very special person will choose the winner. His name’s Jacob Fossley. His surname’s spelled F-O-double S-L-E-Y if you want to read about him online. He lives in our town and he’s a famous photographer.
And the prize? Not a laptop like the prize for the last competition, but a skateboard! This is because it’s the most popular hobby at school!
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear a girl, Martha, talking to her friend, Dan, about a class trip they have been on.
I think this year’s school trip to the lake was much better than last year’s to the sea, Martha.
Yeah Dan, the other class only went to the river.
We did so many activities. I loved horse riding. It was fun.
Oh? I especially liked riding our bikes on those paths. I’d really like to learn windsurfing some time.
Me too.
What was sailing like, Dan?
Well, the teacher explained everything clearly. There was a lot to learn and I kept forgetting what to do next. But, everyone helped each other.
That’s nice.
You didn’t go swimming, Martha. Didn’t you take your swimming things?
I did, but it was such a cold day.
It was fine when I was in the water. But it was deep.
Oh, that’s never a problem for me. I loved having the barbecue by the water.
I thought it was a bit dirty there actually.
Really? I didn’t. But we had to leave so early.
I know. And people weren’t bored.... everyone was having such a great time.
Yeah.
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear a girl talking about buying a present. What kind of present does she decide to buy?

My brother’s bought Mum chocolates for her birthday. Her favourite kind! It’s funny, I was going to buy those too, but I saw some earrings at that new market and I’m going to get them tomorrow. I’d left my purse at home today. It’s an awesome market. My classmate, Ben, bought a really cool T-shirt there.
Seventeen. You will hear a boy leaving a message for his mother. What does he want her to do for him?

Hi, Mum. My bike’s got a flat tyre and I must get my books back to the city library before 5:30. I’ve got extra athletics training which will finish too late for me to walk there. Could you possibly do it for me? They’re on my desk. Thanks! I’ll get you your favourite magazine on my way home.
Eighteen. You will hear a boy talking to his grandmother about his day at school. What did he enjoy most?
How was school today?
Not bad. Our history teacher showed us a documentary about life in Ancient Rome this morning.
Interesting.

A bit boring actually. At lunchtime we had a table-tennis competition. That was the best bit of the day. In the afternoon we started preparing for this year’s concert but I’d forgotten my guitar so I couldn’t do much.
Nineteen. You will hear two friends talking about the clubs they go to after school. What kind of club do they both enjoy going to?
There are brilliant clubs at this school!
I know! I love doing landscape painting after school on Thursdays.
I go to basketball then. It’s fun.
Yeah. I do that on Wednesdays. And on Fridays I sing in the choir!
You are busy! I started playing the trumpet in a jazz band on Mondays as well but I’ve stopped now.
Twenty. You will hear two friends talking about a film. What didn’t they like about the film?
I didn’t really like that film yesterday.
I was disappointed too. The main actor was no good.
I know. He never is.
At least it wasn’t too long!
You’re right. I was pleased when it ended. But the story finished in quite an interesting way, I suppose.
That is the end of Part Four.
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear Alice talking to her friend Jake about what some people in their class will do to help with the school play. What will each person do to help with the play?
Hi, Alice. Are you ready for the school play next week?
Yeah, I’m going to help give people tea and juice during the break, like I did last year.
Cool.
What about you, Jake?
Well, I wanted to help with selling tickets but there’re lots of people already doing that, so I’m going to clean the room after everyone’s finished. Make sure everything’s in the right place.
That’s a lot of work.
I don’t mind.
Do you know if Suzy’s taking the photos? She’s really good at art.
I know, but she’s decided to help with the make-up instead.
So will Dan take the pictures?
Yeah, he loves that. He says it’s easier than tidying up!
So what’s Lauren doing?
She usually makes the clothes. But this time she’s doing the posters to put up round the school.
What will George do?
He’s getting the room ready for the play. He doesn’t like doing stuff like selling tickets.
OK.
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
